prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Implement a simple D flip flop with active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"d":1,"r":1},"outputs":{"q":1},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"Q","meaning":"Stored flip-flop value, driven to q; initial value before first posedge is 0","update_time":"posedge clk","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"R1","outputs":["q"],"condition":"r == 1","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":1,"r":0},{"d":1,"r":1},{"d":0,"r":0}],"expected":[{"q":1},{"q":0},{"q":0}]}},{"id":"R2","outputs":["q"],"condition":"r == 0","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"Implement a simple D flip flop","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":1,"r":0},{"d":0,"r":0},{"d":1,"r":0}],"expected":[{"q":1},{"q":0},{"q":1}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"r","active":"high","values":{"q":0},"first_released_cycle":"first posedge clk with r == 0"},"mid":"Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.","uncertain":[{"rule_id":"global","note":"Initial Q value before first posedge is unspecified; affects first-cycle output when r=0.","candidates":["Q initializes to 0 before any clock edge","Q initializes to 1 before any clock edge","Q is undefined (X) before first posedge"]}]}
response: {"coverage":{"S01":["R1","R2"]},"issues":[{"issue_id":"I1","rule_id":"global","type":"ambiguity","severity":"medium","detail":"Initial Q before first posedge unspecified; first-cycle q when r=0 depends on it.","spec_evidence":"Implement a simple D flip flop with active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0).","alternative":"Q initializes to 1 before any clock edge (so first posedge with r=0 outputs q=1 regardless of d).","sequence":[{"d":0,"r":0}]},{"issue_id":"I2","rule_id":"R1","type":"consistency","severity":"low","detail":"R1 example first vector d=1,r=0 expects q=1, but R1 only covers r==1; that vector is governed by R2/initial state, not R1.","spec_evidence":"active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)","alternative":"","sequence":[]},{"issue_id":"I3","rule_id":"R2","type":"consistency","severity":"low","detail":"R2 example first vector d=1,r=0 expects q=1, which presumes initial Q=0; contradicts the stated unspecified initial value.","spec_evidence":"Implement a simple D flip flop","alternative":"","sequence":[]}]}
